data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of $17.675 million in prior year reserves, representing 5.96% of opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by adverse claims development on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years, partially offset by favorable development on the 2021 underwriting year. Contributing factors included reserving uncertainty, adjustments to reserving methodology based on new business pricing information, a loading for inflation, and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, which contributed to the back year deterioration.

assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business

back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development of $17.675 million was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 20) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2019, 2020, and 2021. This figure is a gross strengthening. The document also explicitly states a net deterioration of $10.197 million in claims reserves established at the prior year end (page 22), which is a net strengthening. The difference suggests significant reinsurance recoveries for prior year movements, but the gross figure from the triangle is used as the primary source for gross prior year development.
